name: Triage new supplier certificates and send actionable Microsoft Teams intake checks

parameters.content:
### How it works
For procurement teams collecting supplier certificates in a dedicated Folderit folder. Each new document receives an intake check for its permitted filename extension and the expiry recorded in Folderit's standard Due date. Missing or invalid dates, past dates and short remaining validity produce a Teams notice with specific corrective actions. Other documents are marked ready for human review, never automatically approved. Retained receipts suppress confirmed repeat notices; uncertain sends stop for manual recovery.

### Setup
Requires Folderit Tailor with API access, n8n Data Table v1.1, and a delegated Microsoft Teams work account allowed to post in your test channel. Install Folderit using the guide below. Tested on n8n **2.46.4 (Cloud)** with **n8n-nodes-folderit 0.4.0**: actual Teams messages, scheduled polling, replay and failure quarantine passed. Library approval is separate.

1. Keep inactive. Run only **1. Set up receipt table** once at a time. Copy its ledgerTableId into **Settings**. Use a separate receipt table for this intake.
2. Select the same **Folderit OAuth2 API** credential and account in the trigger and read action. Set the exact certificate folder, Teams IDs, reviewOwner, allowedExtensions and minimumValidityDays in Settings. Store secrets only in credentials. Enter actual certificate expiry in the standard Folderit Due date; dates are not extracted from documents.
3. In a dedicated folder/channel, activate and allow the initial poll. Upload synthetic ready, missing-date, expired and soon-due documents; inspect actual notices and replay/failure recovery before regular use.

### Customization
Change the minimum validity window and permitted extensions. Dates use UTC. Only new-file arrivals are checked; later corrections and descendants are not monitored. Checks use metadata available at processing time; entering expiry later will not automatically clear a notice. Filename filtering is not file-content validation.

[Workflow image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/folderit-dms/n8n-nodes-folderit/main/examples/assets/supplier-certificate-intake.png) · [Connection guide](https://www.folderit.com/knowledge-base/connect-folderit-to-n8n/) · [Recovery](https://github.com/folderit-dms/n8n-nodes-folderit/blob/main/CUSTOMER-WORKFLOWS.md#recovery-inspect-before-retrying)

## 2 · Check supplier certificate intake
Use one exact intake folder. Compare filename extension and the standard Due date against your intake policy. Missing/invalid dates and short or past validity need attention; a passing check still requires human review of supplier identity and document contents.

## 3 · Process one item at a time
A shared lock serializes overlapping runs. Confirm ownership before continuing. Competing runs wait for about one minute, then stop. Failed runs need inspection; locks do not expire automatically.

## 4 · Skip confirmed arrival notices
Retained completed receipts suppress the same account, audit event and Teams destination. Pending or inconsistent receipts stop for recovery. Changing intake rules does not recheck completed arrivals; later metadata edits need a separate review process.

## 5 · Save a pending attempt first
The saved attempt precedes the Teams message. Its text explains the failed checks, recorded date, reviewer role and next action. It contains document/audit identifiers, not file contents. An uncertain send stays blocked for inspection.

## 6 · Confirm the channel result
Require a Teams message ID before completing the receipt. Acceptance must also read the actual message from the intended channel and confirm its status and corrective action. A successful node alone is insufficient.

## 7 · Complete before unlocking
Confirm the completed receipt, then release the lock for the next document. After failure, reconcile pending outcomes and confirm the old execution has stopped before releasing its lock. Preserve completed receipts; no automatic resend is attempted.

## 1 · Prepare one dedicated intake ledger
Choose a stable table name and execute this manual branch once. It validates or creates the local receipts and lock, without contacting Folderit or Teams. Copy the final ledgerTableId into main Settings; preserve this table on upgrades.
